# FROM MARKERS
## Ohnolog fraction: Mouse
### Using OHNOLOG-V2.0 list
```{r}
## Defining variables
logFC_cut <- 1
adjp_cut <- 0.001

## Loading the ohnologs list
ohnolog_list <- read.table("~/Scratch_MF/MolecularEvolutionAnalysis_July2026/ohnolog_contribution/Data/ohnologs-v2.0_database/rnorvegicus.Pairs.Strict.2R (1).txt", sep = "\t", header = T)
ohnolog_list <- ohnolog_list %>% dplyr::select(Ohno1, Ohno2) %>% pull() %>% unique()

## Loading the markers and filtering
mouse_markers <- read.table(file = "~/Scratch_MF/2026_Falis_et_al/ReferenceFiles/MarkerLists/Complete/RatCompleteAtlas_ByCellType_MinPct0.15_MinDiffPct0.15_MinLogFC0.5_PosOnly_14thAug2026.txt")
mouse_markers$gene <- gsub(pattern = "-.*", replacement = '', x = mouse_markers$gene)
mouse_markers <- mouse_markers %>% dplyr::filter(gene %in% pcg_list) %>% dplyr::filter(avg_log2FC > logFC_cut) %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj < adjp_cut) %>% group_by(cluster) %>% arrange(desc(avg_log2FC), .by_group = T)
mouse_markers <- split(mouse_markers, f = mouse_markers$cluster)

## Computing proportions (counting only expressed genes, then computing proportions)
mouse_genes <- lapply(mouse_markers, FUN = function(x) x %>% pull(gene) %>% unique())
mouse_stats <- lapply(mouse_genes, FUN = function(x) sum(x %in% ohnolog_list) / length(x))
mouse_stats <- mouse_stats %>% as.data.frame() %>% t() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rename("FractionOhnologs" = "V1") %>% rownames_to_column("Cell_Type")
mouse_stats <- mouse_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Class = case_when(Cell_Type %in%  c("SpT", "STGC", "SynTI", "SynTII") ~ "Novel trophoblast",
                                                Cell_Type %in% c("precSTGC", "precSynTI") ~ "Novel trophoblast precursors", 
                                               .default = "Other"))
mouse_stats$Class <- factor(mouse_stats$Class , levels = c("Novel trophoblast", "Novel trophoblast precursors", "Other"))

## Plotting
p1 <- ggplot(data = mouse_stats, aes(x = reorder(Cell_Type, desc(FractionOhnologs)), y = FractionOhnologs, fill = Class)) + 
  geom_point(size = 10, shape = 21, colour = "black", stroke = 1) + 
   theme(panel.background = element_blank(), 
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
        text = element_text(colour = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, colour = "black"), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 37.5, hjust = 1, colour = "black"), 
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20)) + 
  ylab("Fraction of ohnolog markers") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Novel trophoblast" = "#006400", "Novel trophoblast precursors" = "#7FBF7B", "Other" = "#E3D3B3"))
p1

## Saving
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/f_Rat_OhnologFractionStrict_Markers_logFCcut", logFC_cut, "_adjp", adjp_cut, ".png"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)
ggsave(filename = paste0("Visuals/f_Rat_OhnologFractionStrict_Markers_logFCcut", logFC_cut, "_adjp", adjp_cut, ".pdf"), plot = p1, width = 12, height = 10)

## Empty
rm(list = ls())
```
